messages:
maria: Heads up — our nightly evals for quantize-v2 are flaky since the roll yesterday. ~60% of runs finish, the rest hit sampling timeouts (tests timeboxed at 15s, we see processes stuck ~20-30s).

maria: Stacktrace from a stuck worker (strace attached to PID while hung):
```
openat(AT_FDCWD, "/proc/self/stat", O_RDONLY) = 3
getrandom(\"...\", 32, 0)        = ? ERESTARTNOHAND (To be restarted)
--- SIGCHLD (Child exited) ---
```

maria: This seems to always appear on quantized runs (int8) and only on our small VMs (nightly runners). Not seeing it on dedicated.

sam: Interesting — getrandom blocking rings a bell. On some kernels, getrandom can block if entropy pool is empty unless GRND_NONBLOCK is used. Could the sampling code be calling random_device per-sample?

oliver: @maria any chance the quantize-v2 sampler started using std::random_device in the hot loop? I remember a change to switch to hardware RNG for per-token decisions to reduce PRNG correlations.

maria: Yes — PR changed to use random_device inside SampleCandidate::choose(), added last week: https://git/repo/changes/2345 (line ~142). I assumed it's cheap.

jen: If that's true, on VMs without sufficient entropy you'll hit blocking. Repro: run a loop that calls std::random_device()/read from /dev/random around 1000x — should block on low-entropy images.

sam: Can we confirm with `strace -f` on a failing harness worker? If it's getrandom with flags==0, that's the blocking variant. If so, quick fix in harness: set GRND_NONBLOCK or switch to a seeded Xoshiro / pcg at process start and avoid per-sample secure RNG.

maria: Attached full strace and a minimal repro I used on the runner:```
# repro.py
import random, time
for i in range(10000):
    _ = random.SystemRandom().random()
    if i%1000==0:
        print(i)
    time.sleep(0.001)
```
Ran this on a small nightly VM image and it stalls after a few thousand iterations.

oliver: Thanks. That matches. Also seeing `eval-bot` log entries around the same time: `eval-bot: job 82734 started on runner-n3`, `eval-bot: job 82734 finished (timeout)`.

eval-bot: job 82734: started 1982103300, timed out after 15s, exited with signal 9 (OOM?) — note: signal 9 is likely the runner tearing it down.

jen: Actionable mitigations: (1) Patch quantize-v2 to avoid std::random_device per-sample — use a fast seeded PRNG created once per worker. (2) Add a non-blocking fallback for getrandom or explicitly pass GRND_NONBLOCK in any direct calls. (3) Add a harness healthcheck to detect getrandom blocks by sampling timer + syscall stack capture.

sam: I can throw a small patch for (1) — change SampleCandidate::choose() to use thread_local xoshiro seeded from std::random_device() once during worker init. That keeps cryptographically-seeded startup but no per-sample blocking.

maria: Please also add diagnostic logs: if a sampling call takes >50ms, log the current stack and whether it's inside getrandom. Want quick signal to correlate with runner entropy metrics.

oliver: For the short-term hotfix on nightly runners: we can enable `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="random.trust_cpu=on"` or seed the kernel RNG at boot (have cloud-init write to /dev/urandom) — but that's infra heavy. Better to fix code.

jen: Also filing a test case in the eval-harness: simulate low-entropy by blocking /dev/urandom and ensure quantized sampling doesn't stall. I'll add a failing test before the patch so we don't regress.

maria: Great. Prioritization: mark as P0 for nightly stability (we're getting alerts). Sam, can you draft the code patch? Jen, can you add the harness test and the syscall-logging hook? Oliver, can you coordinate with infra if we need temporary runner changes?

sam: On it — will open PR today referencing this thread. Trying to keep the change minimal. cc @jen @oliver

oliver: I'll scope runner changes but prefer code fix. Also adding a short doc blurb in the quantize-v2 changelog explaining the RNG change so future reviewers don't revert to per-sample secure RNG.

maria: Thanks everyone. Will mute alerts for now and watch PRs. :thumbsup:

sam: PR 5432 opened: `quantize-v2: use thread_local xoshiro PRNG seeded at worker start` — includes a small benchmark showing no degradation in sample distribution.

jen: Merged test and added watchdog for syscall hang capture to nightly. If we still see timeouts after the PR lands, we'll attach pprof / userspace stack traces automatically.

maria: After the PR landed on main, ran 50 nightly-equivalent runs on the small VM image — 0/50 timed out. Deploying to nightly in next cycle.

oliver: Nice. Leaving the infra notes in #eng-infra in case we want to seed runners later.

maria: Closing this thread — reopen if regressions reappear.
